column1: # Armoury: river barges (R3-05b, RiverBarges.cs) - strongholds on the same navigable river (Realm of Thrones 8.1.8 map, by hand from A Song of Ice and Fire).
# One row = one town or castle: river<TAB>settlement id<TAB>name. A river system with its forks counts as one river (the Trident with the Red, Blue and Green Fork;
# the Rhoyne with the Little Rhoyne, the Noyne and the Qhoyne; the Mander with the Cockleswhent). A village belongs to the river of its town or castle.
# Only places sure from the canon are listed; a wrong pair gives odd trade, so leave a place out when unsure.
